summary: Right-sided airspace opacity has decreased, but left basilar pleural-parenchymal opacity has increased.

findings.rationale: The dense prior right mid/lower lung airspace opacity has partially cleared on the current image with improved aeration of the right base, despite persistent residual right-sided opacity.
There is more veiling opacity at the left base/retrocardiac region on the current image than previously, compatible with an increased small left pleural effusion with adjacent compressive opacity.
